class: An outside service's outage stopping work that did not need the service
symptom: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana (Workday): after signing in and filling My Information, the run stopped on My Experience with 'could not read this page (Gemini 429: daily allowance used up)', although that page needed only the resume, which the agent attaches itself; the questions left open (Skills, Phone Extension) were optional.
site: Workday (Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana); any page with optional boxes
root_cause: Every empty box counts as an open question; open questions go to the AI; when the AI could not be asked, the run stopped whatever the questions were -- required or not.
why_tests_missed: The tests with a failing AI had required questions left open; none had only optional ones.
fix: PageAgent.carry_on_without_the_ai(): when the AI cannot be asked and no required question is open and the page has a plain way forward, the profile plan is used -- optional boxes are left blank, documents attached, Next pressed -- and the hand-over notes what was left blank. A required question open still stops the run.
prevention: When a helper service is down, ask whether the step actually needs it before stopping; degrade to what can be done without it and say what was skipped.
